title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @framework/presentation/core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary: Implemented @framework/presentation/core with full declarative domain (Presentation, Sequence, Thought, Participant, Embodiment, Arrangement, Transition, intro template) and @framework/presentation/renderer/react (React + reveal.js, mountPresentation, globals.css). Migrated mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to pure declarative index.ts with eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides); removed direct react/reveal/@ui/react deps from the app. All core/renderer tests pass; projektetage production build succeeds.
